title: RNA isolation from human serum and plasma samples using the Norgen exosomal RNA purification mini kit
protocol: Set incubator to 60°C.
Warm PS Solution A, PS Solution B, and PS Solution C for 20 minutes.
Add 50 mL of 96-100% ethanol to Wash Solution.
Check off box on bottle noting addition of ethanol.
Add 10 μl 2-Mercaptoethanol per 1 mL PS Solution B.
Transfer 200 μl biofluid into a microfuge tube.
Add 40 μl PS Solution A and 360 μl PS Solution B to the biofluid.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate for 10 min at 60°C.
Add 600 μl 100% Ethanol.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 1,000 rpm at room temperature.
Carefully decant supernatant.
To the pellet add 300 μl PS Solution C.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate for 10 min at 60°C.
Add 300 μl 100% Ethanol.
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Assemble a mini filter Spin Column with a collection tube.
Transfer 650 μL of the mixture to the Filter Column.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 14,000 rpm at room temperature.
Discard flow-through.
Repeat steps transferring remaining mixture until all added.
Add 400 μL Wash Solution to the column.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 14,000 rpm at room temperature.
Discard flow-through.
Repeat washing with Wash Solution two more times.
Centrifuge the column for 3 minutes at 14,000 rpm at room temperature to dry the column.
Discard the collection tube.
Transfer the spin column to a fresh 1.7 mL elution tube.
Apply 100 μL Elution Solution to the column.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 2,000 rpm at room temperature to load the solution onto the column.
Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 14,000 rpm at room temperature to elute the RNA.
